summary: Every receipts fetch must send Costco's receiptsWithCounts(startDate, endDate, documentType: "all") and read data.receiptsWithCounts.receipts; the plain receipts(startDate, endDate) query returns in-warehouse receipts only.
reason: sync, receipts, spend, savings and the search commands silently omitted every gas-station receipt because the rows never arrived; client-side --type filtering and channel() cannot recover them. documentType is the switch: "all" returns in-warehouse and gas receipts together, "warehouse" returns in-warehouse only, and "gas" is HTTP 400. Costco's live documentType spellings are WarehouseReceiptDetail and FuelReceipts; a regen must re-discover the current names rather than assume the short ones.
validated_outcome: Same three-day window, same token: receipts returned one in-warehouse receipt; receiptsWithCounts(documentType: "all") returned it plus a FuelReceipts receipt, and documentType "warehouse" returned the in-warehouse one only. A 3-year sync on two memberships added 132 gas receipts that the previous query never fetched; the in-warehouse rows were unchanged.
